subject.title: fix(whatsapp): prefix generated Signal public keys

question: Should this provider-protocol change require a real WhatsApp-compatible client run before merge, or are the focused tests and upstream-aligned key boundaries sufficient?
rationale: The repository policy asks for actual-client verification when practical, but the PR supplies only automated validation and does not establish whether live verification is available in this environment.

options.title: Require live interoperability proof
options.body: Request redacted client output or protocol traces showing successful bundle publication and encrypted-session establishment before merge.

options.title: Accept source and test evidence
options.body: Merge after removing the changelog entry while explicitly accepting that live interoperability was not demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Require live interoperability proof
recommendation.body: Request redacted client output or protocol traces showing successful bundle publication and encrypted-session establishment before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member is the only evidence-backed person connected to the branch and can best provide or coordinate the missing protocol proof.
